'''Arteles Kol''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] stationed at [[Aurek Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Peculiar Imperial Activity on Hoth">{{TORcite|type=message|Peculiar Imperial Activity on Hoth|Commander Arteles Kol}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the [[Jedi Consular]]'s second mission to Hoth, if the player mind-tricks the Imperial patrol, then they will receive a message from Kol about how the Imperials attempted an excavation and were killed.<ref name="Peculiar Imperial Activity on Hoth" />
